decisions.decision: The 274 Prospect Street public hearing was continued to the March 28, 2016 Planning Board meeting, at the applicant's request, to allow preparation of multiple renderings by the Landscape Architect (no vote recorded).

decisions.decision: The citizen petition for rezoning of 1026 Northfield Road will be added to the zoning articles hearing on March 14, 2016, for May 7, 2016 Town Meeting (no vote recorded).

budget_items.topic: General bylaw rewording for parcels of 2 or more acres (agricultural threshold)
